create procedure CDN.LokSciezka @SourceName VARCHAR(255), @SourceDatabase VARCHAR(255) , @p_LokId int, @returns varchar(255) OUTPUT as begin
declare @Sciezka varchar(255)
DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(4000) DECLARE @params NVARCHAR(4000)
select @sql = N' select @Sciezka=Lok_Kod from ['+@SourceName+'].['+@SourceDatabase +'].CDN.Lokalizacje where Lok_LokId=@p_LokId ' SELECT @params =N' @p_LokId int, @Sciezka varchar(255) OUTPUT' EXEC sp_executesql @sql, @params, @p_LokId,@Sciezka OUTPUT
if @Sciezka is null or @Sciezka='brak' SET @returns = '' else SET @returns =@Sciezka end
